title: Tomato and Grilled Bell Pepper soup
license_scope: Site-wide dedication covers text and images; no per-recipe license stated.

original_front_matter.title: Tomato and Grilled Bell Pepper soup
original_front_matter.author: thijs-wester

ingredients_source_markdown:
- 10 tomatoes
- 2 red bell peppers
- 2 onions
- 1 clove of garlic
- 1L stock or broth
- ¾t Cayenne pepper
- 1t paprika powder
- 3t bruschetta herbs
- 1t oregano
- 1t giner syrup
- 2T olive oil
- 2T heavy cream
directions_source_markdown:
1. Halve, deseed and grill the bell peppers in an oven or on a grill. Remove skin after grilling.
2. Skin and quarter tomatoes.
3. Sauté onion and crushed garlic in a large soup pan with olive oil.
4. Add broth/stock, tomatoes, bell paper and purée with a stick blender.
5. Add spices, syrup and cream.
